sources.title: Falcon3-3B-Instruct · Models
sources.snippet: Falcon3 family of Open Foundation Models is a set of pretrained and instruct LLMs ranging from 1B to 10B parameters. Falcon3-3B-Instruct achieves strong results on reasoning, language understanding, instruction following, code and mathematics tasks.
